title: Hi, I'm Bernardo Alencar — design and technology, side by side.
paragraphs: I work in design and development, bringing interfaces and visual identity together in a single process. I'm currently a freelance Graphic Designer at Solitu and a Sales Consultant at Loopis Jr, and I take part in team projects like Verde Árido and Guardiões da Bandeira. I started out in graphic design, and over time my interest in technology led me to study Systems Analysis and Development.
I'm naturally curious and enjoy understanding how things work. What drives me most in this work is putting ideas into practice: turning a visual identity on paper into something working on screen.
